source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: D207101 requested a rollback test that failed after doing useful work. The landed test_midwayFail creates 50 messages, keeps every other one, throws halfway through OnMessageRetained, then compares the mbox checksum with its value before compaction. This tests that partial output does not replace the original mbox. The current test still has this case. When changing compaction rollback, trigger a failure after mixed keep/discard work and verify original bytes, not only an immediate listener error.
title: Test rollback after partial mbox work, not only at startup
